name: One Big Number
why_it_works: A single surprising number on a blank screen is a puzzle the brain wants to solve: 'what is that the number of?' Withholding the meaning for one beat buys attention, and one memorable fact is far easier to repeat to a friend than a list of tips.

hook.pattern: Put one big number alone on screen with no context, then make the viewer wait one beat to learn what it measures.
examples: This number changes how you think about {{topic}}.

variables.name: topic
variables.description: The subject area, lowercase, 4 words or fewer

variables.name: what_it_measures
variables.description: What the number is, lowercase so it follows 'It's', 10 words or fewer
variables.example: what $1 buys after 20 years of 3% inflation

variables.name: why_it_matters
variables.description: Why the viewer should care, tied to their life, 12 words or fewer
variables.example: Cash sitting still quietly loses buying power every year

variables.name: action
variables.description: One small thing the viewer can do today, starting with a verb, 6 words or fewer

variables.name: source
variables.description: Where the number comes from, 6 words or fewer

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 minimalist photo of an everyday object that represents '{{what_it_measures}}' on a plain surface, single soft side light, lots of negative space for text

beats.purpose: why it matters to the viewer

visual.prompt: Vertical candid photo of a person at a kitchen table thinking about {{topic}}, laptop or paperwork, warm evening lamp light, mid shot

beats.voiceover: Follow {{brand}} for one number a week.

cta: Follow {{brand}} for one number a week that changes how you see {{topic}}.

craft.notes: The number gets the whole screen and the whole first beat, with nothing else in frame. Choose a number that is surprising but checkable, and put the source on screen at the end so the surprise reads as fact, not clickbait.

do_not: Use a number you cannot source or recalculate
Stack several numbers; one number per reel or it stops being memorable
Pick a scary number with no action attached; fear without a next step feels manipulative
compliance: Financial: no promises or projections of returns; figures are illustrative and must state the assumption; include required firm disclosures (e.g. 'Investment advisory services offered through...')
Insurance: no guaranteed premiums or coverage claims; say 'policies vary, terms apply' and show the agent license where required
Dental and health: cite the published source for any health statistic in the caption; general education, not medical advice
Personal trainer: no guaranteed weight loss or body results; state typical results if a result number is shown
